question: Why did the error rate go up on 16 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Upstream search-cluster is returning HTTP 503, causing service search error rate to spike.
why_chain: Upstream search-cluster is experiencing degraded performance, leading to HTTP 503 errors.
These errors cause service search to fail, increasing error rate.
The error rate increase is observed in service search, with no other service/region segments changing significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume is causing the error rate to rise.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume for service search stayed about the same, with a 24% increase in p95 latency.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a configuration change in service search.
ruled_out.reason: No configuration change is noted in the evidence.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a deployment of a new release or version in service search.
ruled_out.reason: No deployment is noted in the evidence.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Service search's p95 latency is increasing, indicating degraded performance.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service search rose from 0.41% to 4.35% (+948%), with a change point at 2026-03-16T11:05:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service search: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.08).
At the same time, request volume for service search stayed about the same (2454 per 5 min before, 3034 per 5 min after, +24%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service search rose (140 ms before, 255 ms after, +82%).
Upstream search-cluster returning HTTP 503 for search (search; 3 min after the change; record R013; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
search: ERROR upstream search-cluster timeout after 3 retries (search, ap-south; 5 min after the change; record R014; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
search: ERROR upstream search-cluster timeout after 3 retries (search, eu-west; 14 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search-cluster status page: investigating degraded performance (search; 30 min after the change; record R017; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: ERROR upstream search-cluster timeout after 3 retries (search, us-east; 23 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (alerts) lines up in time (3 min after the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Investigate and address the degraded performance of the upstream search-cluster.
Monitor and optimize the performance of the upstream search-cluster.
